hints.title: Optimized Transitions
hints.text: For each value x, transition from same value x with j transitions, or any different value with j - 1 transitions.

hints.title: Maintaining Maxima
hints.text: Maintain max_len[j] storing the global maximum subsequence length with j transitions across all values.

hints.title: Updating in Reverse
hints.text: Iterate j from k down to 0, computing dp[x][j] = max(dp[x][j] + 1, (max_len[j - 1] + 1 if j > 0 else 1)).

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Transitions run in O(1) by caching the global max for each transition level.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^2 * k) quadratic DP exceeds time limits for n = 5000.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Optimize DP transitions from O(n) to O(1) using tracked global maxima.
